programmes.d: Martin and Lucy visit properties in Liverpool, Norfolk and Devon.
Martin & Lucy visit somewhere with lots of potential in Devon, a large property in Wales and a house in Telford, Shropshire.
Martin & Lucy visit a three bed end-of-terrace in Darlington, a property in Fulham, London and a two bed terraced house in Burnley.
Lucy and Martin see a farmhouse cottage with original features in Matlock, Derbyshire; an end-of-terrace in Eastleigh, Hampshire; and a two bedroom.

Lucy Alexander & Martin Roberts visit a building in Harrogate with bags of potential and a jaw dropping history, a unique piece of land in Ashbourne and finally a 3 bedroomed house in Plymouth, Devon with a slippery past.
Martin & Lucy visit a a house in Swindon, a flat in Neasden, Greater London and revisit a fabulous Manor Farm house near Lincoln.
Lucy and Martin visit a property in Wales, a property in London, and a house with a huge cellar in Watford.
Martin & Lucy visit a three bed semi in Stockport, a commercial property in Rochester and a plot of land in Cornwall.
Martin and Lucy view a semi in South Hampton, a house in Folkstone and a little terraced house in Sutton.

Lucy and Martin visit a 14 bedroom former care home in Plymouth, a two bedroom split level flat in Peckham and a three bedroom end of terrace house in Liverpool, with a rather interesting feature. We see who buys them as they go Under The Hammer.
Martin & Lucy visit a well-designed house in Stoke, a maisonette and basement conversion in Kent and a colourful house just outside Nottingham.
Martin and Lucy visit a property in Cornwall, a bungalow in Dorset and a semi detached house in North West Scotland.
Martin and Lucy visit a house in Lincolnshire which must be pretty solid, a piece of land in Swindon with a good opportunity for someone and a grand property in Ipswich.

Lucy and Martin travel to Cornwall to see a hotel; will it be faulty towers all over again or a huge money maker? A three bedroom house in Nottingham in a reasonable location; but needs abit of TLC. In Kent a piece of land right on the sea front.
Martin and Lucy visit a colourful terrace in Penryn, an unusual property in Gillingham and revisit some exciting farm buildings in Cheshire that we first visited two years ago.
Martin and Lucy visit a bungalow in Lincoln with a vital missing door, a 7 bedroom house in South Norwood and a Swindon semi in need of a revamp.
Martin & Lucy visit a site in Ilkeston, Derbyshire, a property in Kent and a cul-de-sac in Warrington.

Martin and Lucy visit an ex miners cottage in Country Durham, a run down bungalow next to a farm in Devon and a three bedroom mid terrace house in Shropshire. We'll find out who buys them at auction and for how much when they go under the Hammer.
Martin and Lucy visit properties in Liverpool, Derby and Norfolk.
Martin & Lucy visit a former Coach House in Devon, a Victorian mid- terrace in London and a detached property in Yorkshire.
Martin and Lucy visit a character flat in London, a period house in Dover and a two bedroom terrace in South Wales with mouthwatering potential.
